name: docket
description: Docket — a privacy-first productivity layer on top of BYU LearningSuite.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/test/fixtures && cp test/fixtures/* dist/test/fixtures/
scripts.sync:demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js sync --source demo
scripts.sync:ics: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js sync --source ics
scripts.reset: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js reset
